content: Kerehuni
'Ixaheritsixi 'axamekateniuyurieni Yawé kemɨkatinake, mɨkɨ kaniwayetuani mariyanitsixi wahetsɨa 'atahuta wiyari.
Kwinimieme mariyanitsixi 'ixaheritsixi mepɨtewananaimakai, 'ayumieme mekaniyuti'awieta hɨritsie terɨta naitsarie hakewa memɨkawaretaxeiyakekai.
Kepauka 'ixaheritsixi memuka'etsakai, mekani'axekaitɨni mariyanitsixi, 'amarekitsixi, meta hipatɨ tau manatineika kiekatari mekaniwarutakukuyakaitɨni.
Mana me'axetɨ waxata mekanitahakekaitɨni, naitsarie wakwietsie Kahatsa paitɨ mekaniye'axekaitɨni. Nitixaɨtɨ mepɨkatekuhayeikawakai 'Ixaheri kwieyaritsie rayeniereme: muxatsi, tuurutsixi, meta puxuri.

Mekani'axekaitɨni yutewama metewaru'arietɨ, meta 'ixuriki kiyari mete'utɨtɨ 'utsikari wahepaɨ mekateniyuxexeiyakaitɨni. Teɨteri meta kameyutsixi yunaitɨ mepɨkayu'inɨatsinɨakai mɨkɨ kwieyaritsie mekanitahakekaitɨni metehakuxɨtɨanike.
Kwinimieme nitixaɨtɨri mepɨkatehexeiyakai 'ixaheritsixi mariyanitsixi mɨyameteyuriekaku, Yawé mekaniutahɨawe me'utitsuatɨ.
Mariyanitsixi mɨyamewayuriekaku kepauka 'ixaheritsixi Yawé memutahɨawixɨ,
Yawé xeime Kakaɨyari niukameya kaniwareyenɨ'airieni, mɨpaɨ kaniutayɨni: «Mɨpaɨ kanaineni Yawé, 'ixaheritsixi wakakaɨyari: “Ne nepɨxe'ayewitɨ 'Ekipitu kwieyaritsie, hakewa xemɨtehe'uximayakai,
kememɨtexe'aitɨakai nepɨxe'uxɨnaxɨ. Yaxeikɨatsiere nepɨxe'uxɨnaxɨ 'iya memɨxe'aye'uniekai wahetsɨa, xehɨxie nepɨwarayewei wakwie nemɨxeyetuirienikɨ”.
Mɨpaɨta nekatinixe'utahɨawe: “Ne Yawé nekanihɨkɨtɨni xekakaɨyari, 'amuxeutsixi wakakaɨyarixi xepɨkawarayexeiyani, xekwietsie memu'uwa”. Peru xeme xepɨkanetsi'anu'eni».

Niuki tuayame Yawé hetsɨa mieme kaninuani, xiu hetɨa kaniutayerɨni 'Upɨra muwekaitɨa, Kuhatsi kwieyatsie, 'Awietsexi xiɨyarieya. Kuhatsi nu'aya Kerehuni tɨriku kanikatsenekaitɨni kaxie matiketsinarɨwatsie yu'awietatɨ, 'iti'utake mariyanitsixi me'ikuxɨnikɨ.
Kepauka niuki tuayame Yawé hetsɨa mieme, Kerehuni hɨxie muyuhekɨataxɨ mɨpaɨ katinitahɨawe: ―Yawé 'ahamatɨa kaniuyeikani, tewi pemɨtɨrɨkaɨye pemeuyutamiewe.

Kerehuni mɨpaɨ kaniutayɨni: ―Xɨka tati'aitɨwame, tahamatɨa 'uyeikani, ¿titayari kuta mɨyatatiyuriene? ¿Hakewatamɨ tapaapama kememɨtatekuxaxatɨwakai mariwemekɨ kemɨtiuyuri: “'Ekipitu Yawé katanayewitɨni”? Yawé katanexɨrieni, kataniyetuani mariyanitsixi wahetsɨa.
Yawé matsi mɨpaɨ katinitahɨawe: ―Kenemie kepemɨtitɨrɨkaɨye, 'ixaheritsixi pekaniwatawikweitsitɨamɨkɨ mariyanitsixi kememɨwayurie. Ne nepɨhɨkɨ nemɨmatsihanunɨ'ani.

Kerehuni mɨpaɨta kaniutayɨni: ―Perutsɨ neti'aitɨwame, ¿'ixaheritsixi kenetiwawikweitsitɨani? Taxiɨyari mɨkatɨrɨkaɨye pɨhɨkɨ Manatsexi hetsiemieme, meta 'iwamarixi ketemɨtapaɨme ne nemɨkaxeiyarie nepɨhɨkɨ.
Yawé mɨpaɨ katinitahɨawe: ―'Ekɨ pepɨwara'iwa mariyanitsixi xewitɨ tewi mɨyɨaneni hepaɨ, netsɨ 'ahamatɨa nekaniuyeikamɨkɨ.
Kerehuni mɨpaɨ kaniutayɨni: ―Xɨka 'aixɨa penetimaika, 'inɨari mariweme ketineuyuri kename 'aku 'ekɨ peyɨane nehamatɨa pemɨtikuxata.
Waɨkawa nepɨmatsiwawirie pepɨkaheyeikani nenuayuke, mawarika neti'atɨayu 'ahɨxie netitipiyuke. Yawé mɨpaɨ kaniutayɨni: ―Nepɨmatsikwewieni kepaukake pemunuani.

Kerehuni kaneyani muxa nunutsi 'itsariyari mekawewienikɨ, yapaɨmemekɨ 'arinakɨ paa mɨkakuxanariyarietɨka kaniutiwewieni. Hikɨ wai tsikɨiwititsie kanikayatsa, xaritata hayari, katinepini niuki tuayame katiniuxatɨani xiu hetɨa.
Niuki tuayame Kakaɨyari hetsɨamieme mɨpaɨ kaniutayɨni: ―Wai kenanatitu'i meta paa mɨkakuxanariyarie, 'ikɨ tetetsie ketinapini manata hayari keneutiyeuri. Kerehuni mɨpaɨ katiniuyurieni.

Hikɨ yu'itsɨ makwekaikɨ, niuki tuayame Yawé hetsɨamieme wai kaniutseni meta paa mɨkakuxanariyarie, hikɨ tetetsie tai kananeni naime kaniutitaiya wai meta paa, hikɨ niuki tuayame hɨxiena kaniukumawere.
Kepauka Kerehuni mɨpaɨ mɨretima, mɨpaɨ kaniutayɨni: ―Xɨari ne nepɨmɨni, niuki tuayame Yawé hetsɨamieme nepuxei nehɨxikɨ.
Peru Yawé mɨpaɨ katinitahɨawe: ―Kayuwatɨ mana keneuyeikani, pepɨkamaka. Pepɨkamɨni.
Hikɨ mana Kerehuni mawari taiyame kaniutawewieni Yawé hetsiemieme, mɨpaɨ katiniterɨwa «Yawé kayuwatɨ mɨtiyupitɨwa», hikɨ mɨkɨ 'akuxi kaneyuhekɨaka 'Upɨra 'Awietsexi kwieyaritsie.

Mɨkɨ tɨkaritsie Yawé mɨpaɨ katinitahɨawe: «Xeime tuuru kenanayehani 'apaapa tewamamatsie, hutariekamieme 'atahuta wiyari hexeiyame. Mawari taiyame keneuta'una 'apaapa mitawewi Wahari hetsiemieme, meta kɨye mana muwe kakaɨyari mana mukuka, 'Atserá 'auriena muwe kenawiteki.

Hikɨ, hɨri heima memuwayuti'awiwietatsie, mawari taiyame keneutawewi Yawé hetsiemieme 'akakaɨyari. Kɨye 'Atserá mana muwekai kɨyexiyari pemitiwitekɨ, keneutataiya mɨkɨ hetsie hutarieka mieme tuuru mawarika taiyariyari hepaɨ».
Kerehuni yakatiniuyurieni Yawé kemɨrehɨawekai tamamata warawitɨtɨ hetsɨana memɨte'uximayakai. Hekɨta kayuwaɨriyatɨ yɨwikɨtake yakatiniuyurieni, yu'iwama wamakatɨ meta teɨteri kiekaritsie memɨtitekai.

Kepauka kiekaritsie kiekatari ximeri memanuku'ui, mekanixeiya mawari taiyame Wahari hetsɨa mieme kani'unikaitɨni, kɨye 'amuwekai kakaɨyari 'Atserá manukukatei nawitekiekaitɨni, mana hutarieka mieme tuuru kanita'ikaitɨni mɨratimawatɨre hekwamekɨ wewiyakametsie.
Mɨpaɨ yunaitɨ mekateniyukɨhɨawekaitɨni: «¿Kemɨ'ane 'ikɨ mɨya pɨtiuyuri?» 'Arike 'anɨkai me'uti'iwauka, mɨpaɨ mekatenetimani: «Kerehuni Kuhatsi nu'aya katiniuyurieni».
Hikɨ teɨteri kiekaritsie kiekatari, Kuhatsi mɨpaɨ mekateniutahɨawe: ―'Aniwe kenewayehani, pɨmɨni, mawari taiyame Wahari hetsɨamieme muta'unaxɨkɨ meta 'Atserá 'ɨkiyari mutataraxɨkɨ.

Peru Kuhatsi mɨpaɨ katiniwarutahɨawe memitate'akai: ―¿Xeme Wahari hetsie xetenua? ¿Xete'itawikweitsitɨanikuta, mɨpaɨ xeteku'eriwa? Kemɨ'ane Wahari mɨwikweitsitɨamɨkɨ, ke'umɨni kakatariwekaku. Xɨka Wahari 'aku kakaɨyaritɨni, mɨyɨkɨhɨani pɨyɨwenikeyu kemɨ'ane mita'una mawari taiyame piinieya.
'Ayumieme mɨkɨ tukaritsie Kerehuni «Yeruwahari» mekateniuterɨwa, mɨpaɨ me'utiyuatɨ: «Wahari keyukɨhɨani 'iya hetsiemieme», mɨkɨ mita'unaxɨkɨ.
Yunaitɨ mariyanitsixi meta 'amarekitsixi meta hipatɨ teɨteri tau manatineika kiekatari, mekaniuyunɨni Kurutani hatuxameyaritsie mekanakɨne, Ketsireri mayeweritsie mekanitiyaxe.
Hikɨ Kerehuni 'Iyarikɨ hɨnetɨ Yawé hetsɨamieme, kuxineta kaniutahɨtsieni, yunaitɨ 'Awihetsexi niwemama mekaniuta'inierieni memenuweiyakɨ.

Niukamete kaniwarenɨ'ani Manatsexi xiɨyarimama wahetsɨa, memɨwareta'inienikɨ memenukuweiyakɨ, yaxeikɨata katinenɨ'ani 'Atsexi xiɨyarimama, Tsawuruni, Nepɨtahari xiɨyarimama wahetsɨa meminɨnikɨ, mɨkɨta mekaniparewieni.
Kerehuni Kakaɨyari mɨpaɨ katiniutahɨawe: «Xɨka 'ixaheritsixi pewatawikweitsitɨamɨkɨ ne 'aixɨa nemɨtiuka'iyarikɨ, kepemɨnerahɨawekai,

neuxei ne muxa huxarieya 'ena nepɨtiwiwieni kwiepa. Xɨka haɨtsi mɨkɨtsie xeikɨa 'ukaxɨrieni xɨka 'auriena kwiepa hawakitɨkani, 'ana mɨpaɨ nepɨretimani kename 'ixaheritsixi pewatawikweitsitɨani nekɨmana, kepemɨnerahɨawekai».
Mɨpaɨ katiniuyɨni. 'Uxa'arieka ximeri kananukukeni Kerehuni, mɨkɨ muxa huxarieya kaniutahirumina, xeiwatsuyari haa kanayani.

Hikɨ Kerehuni Kakaɨyari mɨpaɨ katiniutahɨawe: «Pepɨkaha'aka nehamatɨa. Keneneupitɨa tawarita nemetitawawirienikeyu. Tawarita 'inɨari keneuwewi 'ikɨ muxa huxarieyakɨ. Hikɨta 'ikɨ muxa huxarieya kewakini, 'aurienata kwiepa kehakuyunani haɨtsikɨ».
Mɨpaɨ katiniuyurieni Kakaɨyari mɨkɨ tɨkaritsie. Mɨkɨ muxa huxarieya kaniwakikaitɨni, peru 'auriena naitɨ kwiepa kanakuhaɨtsiyakaitɨni.
